definitions.explanation: The ability to understand things deeply and make good judgments.

examples.japanese: {見識|けんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧。
{見識|けんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
{見識|けんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧。

notes:
{見識|けんしき} refers to deep understanding and sound judgment gained through experience and study. It implies wisdom rather than mere knowledge.

REGISTER:
This is a formal word often used in written language, business, and academic contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見識|けんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧: having great/broad insight
- {見識|けんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have insight
- {見識|けんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person with discernment
- {見識|けんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to broaden one's views

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧: knowledge (factual information)
- ⟦{洞察|どうさつ}→洞察：09114_dousatsu⟧: insight, perception (seeing through)
- ⟦{識見|しきけん}→識見：20752_shikiken⟧: views, opinion (more formal variant)
